title: Economics baseline schedule
unit: testnet accounting unit, no market value (D-T4); ALCRY does not exist until T1
amount_rule: 1 + draw % 997, capped at the sender balance by the runner
invariants: sum(balances) == genesis_total + declared emission (no emission from nowhere)
a transfer cannot spend more than the sender has
the run is bit-exact reproducible from the seed
